summary: The registrant filed an 8-K (items 8.01 and 9.01) solely to report that it had regained compliance with Nasdaq's minimum bid price requirement after its common stock closed at $1.00 or higher for 12 consecutive business days ending May 18, 2026. This disclosure is a routine compliance update and does not represent a special situation—there are no merger, acquisition, tender offer, strategic review, or activist campaign elements. The filing confirms the prior deficiency (from December 9, 2025) is resolved, and Nasdaq has closed the matter. No further action or risk-arb angle applies.
